$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — DesignSourceSnapshot. Major version 1. TRANSPORT payload only: the bounded, revision-pinned subtree document a design-source adapter returns on stdout after reading the caller-selected root. This is NOT the converter family's DesignSourcePort — that stays a typed core interface by contract (ADR-005-013); the core constructs its in-memory port implementation FROM this snapshot. Adapter-defined node kinds, names and properties are open vocabulary here; the core's deterministic extraction maps them onto the closed NodeIR enums and never guesses. Locators are adapter-defined opaque identifiers; no provider grammar is baked into this schema.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Design Source Snapshot (transport)

sourceId.description: Profile-declared source id (echoed from the adapter input). The core rejects a snapshot claiming a different source identity than the profile resolved (INPUT_CONTRACT_MISMATCH).

revisionId.description: Opaque adapter-defined source revision token pinned for this snapshot. Node ids are locator-keyed and revision-independent; every downstream payload pins this revision.

rootLocator.description: Locator of the caller-selected root exactly as requested. A snapshot rooted anywhere else is a scope escape and is rejected.

nodes.description: The complete subtree under rootLocator (root included), flat. Hidden layers, instances, decorations and unknown nodes included — the adapter must not pre-filter semantics.

locator.description: Adapter-defined opaque node identifier, unique within the snapshot. Never interpreted by the core.

kind.description: Adapter-defined source kind (open vocabulary). The core maps known families onto the closed NodeIR enum; unmappable kinds become 'unknown' with a NOT_VERIFIED warning.

name.description: Source layer label verbatim (required — the label is evidence even when machine-generated).

visible.description: Source visibility at the pinned revision. Hidden nodes are transported, never dropped.

componentRef.description: For instances: locator of the referenced shared component definition. May point outside the extracted scope (external library) — the core records that honestly as REFERENCE_ONLY.

properties.description: Adapter-defined properties (open object, byte-capped by the runtime). Conventional optional keys the core reads: 'layout' (NodeIR layout primitives, verbatim), 'variants' (string map consumed as element variantAssignment), 'dynamicSlots' (array of {slotId, kind, valueRef}). Unknown properties stay unknown — never guessed.

children.description: Child locators in source document order. Every referenced locator must exist in the snapshot exactly once; dangling or cyclic references fail closed (EVIDENCE_MISSING).
